title: Remove Diagnostics log guidance flat export
summary: Removed diagnosticsLogGuidanceLines from the transitional flat window export set while preserving the Diagnostics namespace export and static coverage.
reason: Continue reducing WebView flat compatibility exports by touched Diagnostics domain without changing Diagnostics rendering behavior or backend-owned mutation boundaries.
behavior_before: diagnosticsView.js exported diagnosticsLogGuidanceLines both through window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView and as window.diagnosticsLogGuidanceLines.
behavior_after: diagnosticsView.js keeps diagnosticsLogGuidanceLines on window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView only, and static coverage rejects reintroducing the flat window assignment.
tests_added: Updated LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert diagnosticsLogGuidanceLines remains namespace-exported and is no longer assigned as a flat window export.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_diagnostics_handoff_smoke -q (passes with the existing malformed broken-active-job.json warning)
rollback_plan: Restore the window.diagnosticsLogGuidanceLines assignment in diagnosticsView.js, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and restore the flat-export counts/inventory entry.
